notes: Part of the PLAN 3.1 population sample: 15 skills drawn by even stride from the path-sorted library, one task each, to estimate how much of the library adds nothing measurable over a bare model. One task cannot characterise a skill — this measures the population, not this skill.

tasks.prompt: Review the sign-up form in our Material 3 Android app. It uses outlined text fields whose only label is a placeholder that vanishes on focus, and after submit it shows a red "Invalid" line under the email field. What should change?

expect.label: says a placeholder cannot serve as the label
asks for error text that says what is wrong and how to fix it
expect.pattern: specific|actionable|what(?:'s| is) wrong|(?:how )?to fix|why it failed|tells? (?:the )?user nothing|complete the sentence

expect.pattern: on blur|as they type|before submit|inline valid|after the user
